IndCompText: Your broker and/or their agency could also be eligible to earn between $100 and $700 on the sale of this plan if certain criteria is met and your plan is a part of the eligible criteria. Criteria may include a minimum of 10-30 applications submitted by a broker or 50-1,000 applications submitted by an agency, within a certain time frame, and meet other conditions including plans staying in effect for a required amount of time. Your broker may be eligible as well to earn a trip worth about $6,000 based on at least 500 points earned on eligible Short Term Limited Duration plan sales that meet other similar criteria during a set time frame.
